blocks.title: Association
blocks.text: Association do classes ka rishta hai. Is ki do qismein hain: aggregation aur composition.

items: Aggregation: ek class (Library) doosri (Book) rakhti hai magar us ki malik nahi; kitabein library ke baghair reh sakti hain.
Composition: ek class (House) doosri (Room) rakhti aur us ki malik hai; kamre ghar ke baghair nahi reh sakte.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class Book:
....def __init__(self, title):
........self.title = title

class Library:
....def __init__(self):
........self.books = []
....def add_book(self, book):
........self.books.append(book)

class Room:
....def __init__(self, name):
........self.name = name

class House:
....def __init__(self):
........self.rooms = [Room("Living Room"), Room("Bedroom")]

blocks.prompt: Student aur school aggregation hai ya composition?
blocks.explanation: Aggregation: school mein students hain, magar student school se alag bhi maujood hai.

items: Association: aggregation (rakhta hai, malik nahi: Library aur Book) aur composition (malik: House aur Room).
